headline: Meta unveils VR Glasses and camera-free smart glasses at Connect
summary: At its Meta Connect 2026 event in Menlo Park, Meta announced new VR Glasses using hand and eye tracking, priced at $1,300, alongside Ray-Ban Meta Audio, its first smart glasses without a camera. The debut comes amid backlash over privacy concerns tied to camera-equipped wearables, and outlets differ on how immersive the new VR glasses are.
